neighbours.label: the slot right before a quantity noun such as weight, power, mass or space ('lose __', 'gain more __', 'a lot more __', 'plenty of counter __')
fire: After the surgery he began to lose weight quickly.
Teenagers in the study who skipped breakfast tended to gain more weight.
The upgraded turbo gives the truck a lot more power on hills.
Doctors told her she needed to put on weight before the treatment.
The renovated flat has plenty of counter space for cooking.
Swimming is a gentle way for older adults to lose weight.
Bigger tyres let the bike carry a lot more weight on rough roads.
Low-calorie drinks did not help the volunteers lose weight.
quiet: After the surgery he began to walk again quickly.
Teenagers in the study who skipped breakfast tended to feel more tired.
The upgraded seats give the truck a lot more comfort on long trips.
Doctors told her she needed to rest at home before the treatment.
The renovated flat has two large windows facing the park.
Swimming is a gentle way for older adults to make friends.
Bigger tyres let the bike handle rough roads a lot more smoothly.
Low-calorie drinks did not help the volunteers sleep better.
